title: Settings
description: V6 (nested pages) with two content explorations. 1) A re-ordered, expanded Commonly Used list (18 settings: appearance and readability first, then saving/formatting, editing, AI, terminal and files; adds Zoom Level, Minimap, Inline Suggestions, Terminal Font Size and Default Profile, and File Icon Theme). 2) A visual theme picker on Appearance › Color Theme: a Match System / Light / Dark mode choice with workbench previews, and a grid of theme cards with miniature workbench + code previews built from each built-in theme's real colors (including light/dark preferences when matching the system).
